h100_sxm_reference.name: h100_sxm_reference
assumptions: Dense BF16 peak = published sparse peak 1979 / 2 TFLOP/s
NVLink one-direction peak = published bidirectional 900 / 2 GB/s
50 GB/s inter-node per GPU is a 400 Gb/s reference scenario, not measured cluster bandwidth
Collective efficiencies and latencies are analytical priors
